description.value:
Traits Signal

Encore you would gain while already at your cap is no longer lost. Instead it is held in reserve, up to 3 points. Whenever your Encore pool drops below your cap, reserve is released into the pool immediately, one point at a time, until either the reserve is empty or you are back at cap. Reserve is not part of your pool: it cannot be spent directly, and Crescendo does not consume it. The reserve empties when your Broadcast ends, exactly as the pool does.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 — needs both the base resource and a second linked reserve pool, neither of which exists. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either.
